description_en: Queries the details of an Express Connect failover test job by calling the DescribeFailoverTestJob operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeFailoverTestJob接口查询高速通道故障演练任务详情
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-failover-test-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --job-id ftj-bp1yh6mvi13aq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFailoverTestJob

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the failover test job. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
故障演练任务所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the failover test job
parameters.name: job_id
